verdict.rationale: Browser Use can be driven entirely from code without a UI. Cloud SDK calls such as `client.runs.create` run tasks on remote managed browsers, and progress is tracked by polling `runs.events()`. Results come back as JSON that can be validated client-side, and a Python library automates the web 'from your own code', all of which fits unattended scripted or CI use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a headless mode or CI pipeline setup (e.g. GitHub Actions guide, secrets handling), independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
